2026-2027.coverage_note: Dekker den publiserte felles skoleruta for offentlige grunnskoler og videregående skoler. Oslo kommune opplyser at datoer kan endres når Utdanningsdirektoratets eksamensplan foreligger; planleggingsdager er inkludert i oppførte ferier og fridager.
2026-2027.coverage_note_en: Covers the published shared calendar for public primary and upper secondary schools. Oslo municipality says dates may change when the national exam schedule is published; planning days are included in the listed holidays and days off.

holidays.name: Sommerferie
holidays.source_note: Inclusive interval after the published last school day (18 June 2027) and before the published first school day of 2027/2028 (16 August 2027).

2026-2027.coverage_note: Delvis dekning for kommunale barne- og ungdomsskoler: felles ferier og publiserte skolefrie dager er tatt med. Planleggingsdager varierer mellom skoler og SFO og må kontrolleres på den enkelte skoles nettside.
2026-2027.coverage_note_en: Partial coverage for municipal primary and lower secondary schools: shared holidays and published school-free days are listed. Planning days vary by school and SFO and must be checked on the individual school's website.

holidays.name: Juleferie
holidays.source_note: Inclusive break interval between last school day before Christmas (18 December 2026) and first school day after (4 January 2027), as published by Trondheim municipality.

holidays.name: Sommerferie
holidays.source_note: Inclusive interval after the published last school day (18 June 2027) and before the published first school day of 2027/2028 (23 August 2027).
